claim: EAGLE, an ACCEPTED AAAI-26 main-track paper on LLM self-verbalized calibration, was evaluated on multiple diverse datasets and multiple LLMs against multiple existing baselines, not a single benchmark/single model.
stance_target: accepted AAAI calibration papers require multi-dataset, multi-model, multi-baseline evaluation
scope_conditions: AAAI-26 Technical Track on NLP V, accepted paper
quoted_support: Extensive experiments on diverse datasets and LLMs demonstrate that EAGLE significantly improves calibration performance over existing baselines.

claim: EAGLE includes three separate mechanism-probing ablation/analysis studies beyond the headline calibration number: layer-wise uncertainty pattern examination, self-evaluation prompt sensitivity, and self-evaluation score-range effects.
stance_target: accepted AAAI calibration papers require ablation depth beyond a single headline metric
quoted_support: We also provide an in-depth analysis of EAGLE, including a layer-wise examination of uncertainty patterns, a study of the impact of self-evaluation prompts, and an analysis of the effect of self-evaluation score range.
